description.value: When held, a magical flame appears at the top of this weapon's handle. The flame sheds Bright Light in a 20-foot radius and Dim Light for an additional 20 feet. You can snap the handle down as if cracking a whip (no action required) to cause the flame to extend into a 10-foot-long coil of fire, which you can use as a Whip. This weapon has the Light property and deals Fire damage on a hit instead of Slashing. The flame doesn't hurt you while you hold the Whip. As a Bonus Action, you can snuff the fire out with your hand or blow it out to extinguish it.
The Whip's flame is intangible and can't be used to bind a creature or retrieve objects from afar, but can be used to light other fires.

description.name: Finesse
description.value: When making an attack with a Finesse weapon, use your choice of your Strength or Dexterity modifier for the attack and damage rolls. You must use the same modifier for both rolls.

description.name: Reach
description.value: A Reach weapon adds 5 feet to your reach when you attack with it, as well as when determining your reach for Opportunity Attacks with it.

description.name: Light
description.value: When you take the Attack action on your turn and attack with a Light weapon, you can make one extra attack as a Bonus Action later on the same turn. That extra attack must be made with a different Light weapon, and you don't add your ability modifier to the extra attack's damage unless that modifier is negative. For example, you can attack with a Shortsword in one hand and a Dagger in the other using the Attack action and a Bonus Action, but you don't add your Strength or Dexterity modifier to the damage roll of the Bonus Action unless that modifier is negative.

description.name: Slow
description.value: If you hit a creature with this weapon and deal damage to it, you can reduce its Speed by 10 feet until the start of your next turn. If the creature is hit more than once by weapons that have this property, the Speed reduction doesn't exceed 10 feet.

A mote of swirling, magic water circles the top of this wooden staff, which can be wielded as a magic Quarterstaff. The staff can also be used to make special melee attacks by extending and lashing out with the water. You're proficient with these attacks, which have a reach of 10 feet, can use your Wisdom modifier for their attack rolls and damage rolls instead of Strength, and deal **1d4** Bludgeoning damage on a hit. After the attack, the water shrinks back to the staff. You gain a +1 bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls made with this magic weapon, regardless of whether you attack with the weapon itself or use its special melee attack.

While holding the staff, you can stand on and move across any liquid surface as if it were solid ground. If you end your turn on a liquid in this way, you sink into it as normal until you stand on solid ground again. In addition, while holding the staff, you can cast the __Control Water__ spell ("flood" or "part water" only) from it. The spell ends early if you are no longer holding the staff. Once the staff is used to cast this spell, it can't do so again until the next dawn.

description.value: A Versatile weapon can be used with one or two hands. A damage value in parentheses appears with the property. The weapon deals that damage when used with two hands to make a melee attack.

description.name: Topple
description.value: If you hit a creature with this weapon, you can force the creature to make a Constitution saving throw (DC 8 plus the ability modifier used to make the attack roll and your Proficiency Bonus). On a failed save, the creature has the Prone condition.

This canvas bag holds 5d8 + 10 clove and pumpkin candies inside. A small illusory face appears over the sewn-on pumpkin at night. Each candy has a minor magical effect that lasts for 1 minute unless otherwise specified. Some effects are pleasant, whereas others are mischievous. You can eat a piece of candy as a Magic action. When you do, roll on the table below to determine the candy's effect.

rows: The candy seems to have spoiled, forcing you to succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or spend your action on your next turn retching and reeling.
Your face appears to melt, revealing the skull beneath it. The effect is harmless and illusory.
Any food you eat or water you drink taste like ash or blood, respectively.
Other creatures' eyes appear to be hollowed out and blackened to you.
Your ears turn a different, vibrant color at the start of each of your turns.
Your hair falls out and regrows over the next minute.
Your laughter becomes maniacal, and you have trouble stopping once you've started.
You hear a fly near your ear, but you can neither see it nor swat it away.
Your skin turns orange, and light spills forth from your eyes and mouth, shedding Bright Light in a 10-foot radius and Dim Light for an additional 10 feet.
Confetti bursts from the top of your head, and small children can be heard laughing.
You sprout tiny, flightless bat wings.
You know the location of the nearest pumpkin within 1 mile.
Nearby crows and ravens land on your shoulders or outstretched arm.
A friendly, floppy wizard hat appears on your head. After 1 minute, it disappears in a cloud of stars.
Any alcohol in your stomach or that you drink becomes nonalcoholic.

Your voice becomes smooth and golden, allowing you to add your Proficiency Bonus to Charisma (Performance) checks made to sing. If you already have proficiency in this skill, you have Expertise in it instead.
Any food you eat or water you drink tastes delicious and reminds you of your favorite pastimes.
You gain Darkvision with a range of 30 feet. If you already have Darkvision, its range increases by 30 feet.
You can magically sense if a creature is possessed, and you can see creatures that have the Invisible condition.

description.value: This large shield provides more protection than a typical shield. While wielding a Tower Shield, you gain +3 to Armor Class. If you use an action to set the Tower Shield, you have Three-Quarters Cover until the start of your next turn. Additionally, your Speed becomes 0 and cannot be increased during that time.
To wield a Tower Shield, you must have a Strength of at least 15 and your Speed is reduced by 10 feet while wielding the shield.

name: Toy Riverboat

description.value: This tiny, brightly painted boat is made in exacting detail, with smokestacks and a paddlewheel that turns, but it looks like a child's plaything. Studying it reveals a miniscule but unearthly passenger within the boat's cabin. The riverboat grants the following properties.

description.name: Passengers
description.value: As a Magic action, you and up to twelve other willing, Medium or smaller creatures you can see within 30 feet of yourself shrink to Tiny size and appear aboard the riverboat, along with up to 300 pounds of gear per passenger. The boat moves over water or other liquids at 3 miles per hour and doesn't require wind. You can travel this way for up to 12 hours a day. A passenger that leaves the boat returns to its normal size.

description.name: Unearthly Passenger
description.value: You can release the riverboat onto water to cast __Arcane Eye__ with it. The riverboat is the spell's sensor and only moves on water, but you can otherwise move it as normal for the spell.

description.name: Haunting Curse
description.value: When a creature leaves the riverboat, it must make a DC 0 Charisma saving throw, becoming cursed on a failed save. While cursed in this way, it has Disadvantage on Wisdom and Charisma ability checks and on saving throws to avoid or end the Frightened condition. After you make this saving throw, the save DC increases by 2. This increase can't happen again until you finish a Long Rest.

description.name: Lingering Curses
description.value: Ending your Attunement to one of these items removes its curse, but the power of a Cursed Curio doesn't release its hold on the user easily. If you attune to it again within 28 days, the progression of its curse returns to where it was before you ended your Attunement.

properties: ending your attunement to one of these items removes its curse, but the power of a cursed curio doesn't release its hold on the user easily. if you attune to it again within 28 days, the progression of its curse returns to where it was before you ended your attunement.

description.value: A jasper effigy of a chicken's head rests at the top of this trident, and an egg-shaped amethyst is fixed to its base. It is a strange weapon, but is highly coveted by farmers and livestock owners.

This magic weapon has 4 charges, and regains 1d4 expended charges at dawn. When you use the Attack action with this weapon, you can immediately expend 1 of its charges to cast the __Polymorph__ spell (save DC 15) and transform your target into a hen (AC 10, HP 1, Speed 30 ft) for 1 hour. If you expend the weapon's last charge, roll 1d4. On a 1, yolk explodes out of the egg-shaped gem at the base of the trident and the weapon loses its enchantment.

description.name: Thrown
description.value: If a weapon has the Thrown property, you can throw the weapon to make a ranged attack, and you can draw that weapon as part of the attack. If the weapon is a Melee weapon, use the same ability modifier for the attack and damage rolls that you use for a melee attack with that weapon.

description.name: Versatile
description.value: A Versatile weapon can be used with one or two hands. A damage value in parentheses appears with the property. The weapon deals that damage when used with two hands to make a melee attack.

description.name: Topple
description.value: If you hit a creature with this weapon, you can force the creature to make a Constitution saving throw (DC 8 plus the ability modifier used to make the attack roll and your Proficiency Bonus). On a failed save, the creature has the Prone condition.

This magical wooden Trident has 4 charges and regains 1d3 + 1 expended charges daily at dawn. While you're holding the Trident and are within 5 feet of a Large or bigger tree, you can take a Bonus Action and expend 1 charge to magically teleport to an unoccupied space within 5 feet of a second Large or bigger tree that is within 60 feet of the previous tree.

description.name: Tree Form
description.value: You can take a Magic action to plant the bottom of this Trident in fertile ground and use a command word to transform it into a healthy tree. The tree is 60 feet tall and has a 5-foot-diameter trunk, and its canopy extends out in a 20-foot Emanation around the tree. While you're within 5 feet of the tree, you can take a Bonus Action and expend 1 charge to magically teleport to another point on its trunk or within its branches.

The tree appears ordinary but radiates a faint aura of Transmutation magic that can be discerned with the __Detect Magic__ spell. While touching the tree, you can take a Magic action and repeat the command word to return the Trident to its normal form. Any creature in the tree falls when the tree reverts to a Trident. Once this property is used, it can't be used again until the next dawn.

If the weapon is a Melee weapon, use the same ability modifier for the attack and damage rolls that you use for a melee attack with that weapon.

description.value: A Versatile weapon can be used with one or two hands. A damage value in parentheses appears with the property. The weapon deals that damage when used with two hands to make a melee attack.

description.value: If you hit a creature with this weapon, you can force the creature to make a Constitution saving throw (DC 8 plus the ability modifier used to make the attack roll and your Proficiency Bonus). On a failed save, the creature has the Prone condition.

This oddly shaped Trident is made of hammered mithral and has a strangely short handle, but it is well-balanced for single-handed combat. You gain a +1 bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls made with this magic weapon, which lacks the Versatile property.

When you make an attack by throwing the Trident, the forked end of the weapon magically splits apart to form three separate spears, allowing you to make three ranged attack rolls with it instead of one. These spears each deal **1d6** Piercing damage on a hit instead of the Trident's normal damage; you don't add your ability modifier to their damage unless that modifier is negative. After the attack, the Trident regrows its missing prongs from one of the separated spears, and the other two spears dissolve.

If the weapon is a Melee weapon, use the same ability modifier for the attack and damage rolls that you use for a melee attack with that weapon.

This potion is a bubbling, sickly, green-brown viscous soup that has the consistency of mucus. What appears to be the rotting eye of a troll floats in the potion. It smells acrid and nauseating and tastes even worse than it looks.
When you drink this potion, for the next minute, you regain 5 Hit Points at the start of your turn. The effects of this potion end early if you take Fire or Acid damage.

description.name: Crafting
description.value: Creating a Trollblood Potion requires a Rare Workshop and the following Rare Components:

entries: **[Animus]**: Fey Animus
**[Fluid]**: Monster Blood from a Troll
**[Organ]**: Eyes from a Troll

description.value: This squat, wooden and ceramic tub has a screw-on lid that fits snuggly around its base. The tub can hold up to 2 gallons of liquid or 1 cubic foot of material within it. You can leave a liquid or other perishable in the tub and secure the lid before saying the name of the end product you'd like the contents to turn into. If you say the name of a possible result, the tub clicks lightly before locking its lid shut.

After 10 minutes, the tub gives a second, louder click as the lid unlocks. The contents of the tub will have been stirred, processed, or otherwise fermented in such a way to generate the named end product. Adding extra ingredients into the tub can impact the end product's flavor.
Once this property is used, it can't be used again until the next dawn.
From the tip of its thick steel blade to the base of its golden handle, each knife shimmers with a buzz of illusory energy.

While wielding a pair of Turtle Dove Daggers, you can create an illusory copy of yourself as an Action twice per long rest. The illusion lasts for 1 minute, or until you take damage. The illusion appears in an unoccupied space that you can see within 30 ft of you. You can take an Attack or Magic action on your turn to attack or cast a spell as if you were in the illusion's space, but you must use your own senses. As a Bonus Action, you can move the illusion up to 30 ft to a space you can see, but it must remain within 120 ft of you. Additionally, when both you and your illusion are within 5 ft of a creature that can see the illusion, you have advantage on attack rolls against that creature.

description.name: Finesse
description.value: When making an attack with a Finesse weapon, use your choice of your Strength or Dexterity modifier for the attack and damage rolls. You must use the same modifier for both rolls.

description.name: Light
description.value: When you take the Attack action on your turn and attack with a Light weapon, you can make one extra attack as a Bonus Action later on the same turn. That extra attack must be made with a different Light weapon, and you don't add your ability modifier to the extra attack's damage unless that modifier is negative. For example, you can attack with a Shortsword in one hand and a Dagger in the other using the Attack action and a Bonus Action, but you don't add your Strength or Dexterity modifier to the damage roll of the Bonus Action unless that modifier is negative.

description.name: Thrown
description.value: If a weapon has the Thrown property, you can throw the weapon to make a ranged attack, and you can draw that weapon as part of the attack. If the weapon is a Melee weapon, use the same ability modifier for the attack and damage rolls that you use for a melee attack with that weapon.

description.name: Nick
description.value: When you make the extra attack of the Light property, you can make it as part of the Attack action instead of as a Bonus Action. You can make this extra attack only once per turn.
Ulmyr's Eye appears to be a crystal ball filled with ever-shifting smoke. Peering into the orb reveals hazy visions, many of which are disturbing.

description.name: Aspirant
description.value: At this tier of Attunement, you have the following benefits:

entries: You know the __Guidance__ cantrip and can cast it even if you don't have the Spellcasting class feature.

The orb has 12 charges. You can expend 1 or more charges to cast one of the following spells (save DC 18) from it: __Augury__ (2 charges), __Clairvoyance__ (3 charges), __Detect Thoughts__ (2 charges), __Divination__ (4 charges), or __Scrying__ (5 charges). The orb regains 2d4 + 4 expended charges at dawn.

description.value: You also gain the following curse:

entries: Your fears of the future diminish your attention in the present. While attuned to Ulmyr's Eye, you have Disadvantage on Wisdom (*Perception*) and Intelligence (*Investigation*) checks.

description.name: Adept
description.value: At the Adept tier of Attunement, you have the following additional benefits:

entries: While holding the orb, you can use your Reaction to give Advantage or Disadvantage on a roll when a creature you can see within 60 feet makes D20 Test. The triggering creature rerolls and uses the new result. You can use this property a number of times equal to your Proficiency Bonus, regaining all expended uses when you finish a Long Rest.
While holding the orb, you can expend 1 or more of its charges to cast one of your prepared spells without expending a spell slot. The number of charges expended is equal to the spell's level.

description.value: You also gain the following curse:

entries: Ulmyr's Eye fills your dreams and meditations with nightmarish visions, making it difficult for you to rest. When you finish a Long Rest, you must succeed a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw or gain only the benefits of a Short Rest instead.

description.name: Master
description.value: While at the Master tier of Attunement, you have the following additional benefit:

entries: While holding the orb, you can cast the __Foresight__ spell from it, requiring no Material component. When you cast the spell in this way, its duration is reduced to 1 hour. Once you have done so, you can't cast the spell from the orb again until you finish a Long Rest.

description.value: You also gain the following curse:

entries: You are so filled with dread that you suffer frightful visions difficult to discern from reality. When you roll Initiative, the orb casts __Phantasmal Killer__ on you (save DC 14). This effect can also be triggered by moments of extreme emotional or physical distress, at the GM's discretion.

description.value: This brass cup changes the flavor of any water it's holding. As a Bonus Action, you can whisper the name of a fruit into the cup. If the cup is filled with water, the water's color and flavors magically change to resemble that kind of fruit juice. Saying the name of another fruit changes the water's color and flavors again. Regardless of its color and flavors, the water is still only water. Shouting into the cup causes the juice to effervesce and bubble. If the water is poisoned, the drink tastes foul and badly fermented.

This iron token is inlaid with a sliver of a Siberys dragonshard. Most are worn as brooches, but others take the form of coins or keys. While an Uul'kur is a Common magic item, the secret of their creation is known only to the chot'uul monks of the Heirs of Dhakaan, and they are largely unknown in the Five Nations.

When you sleep with an Uul'kur on your person, you remain fully lucid when you dream, and when you wake, you clearly remember everything that transpired. If you understand the workings of the Uul'kur, you can take a Magic action to bind it to your dreams until the next dawn. While bound, any creature who sleeps with this token on its person shares your dream instead of creating its own, provided you are asleep at the same time.
(Requires the __Mark of Handling__)
This ring has 3 charges, and it regains 1d3 expended charges daily at dawn. While wearing the ring, you can expend 1 charge to cast one of the following spells (save DC 13) from it:

entries: __Animal Friendship__
__Fear__ (affects Beasts only)
__Speak with Animals__

description.value: This potion is a crimson-red bubbling brew that tastes distinctly of copper. When you drink this potion, you gain the following benefits for the next minute:

entries: You gain Advantage on Strength, Dexterity, and Charisma attack rolls, ability checks, and saving throws.

If damage reduces you to 0 Hit Points, you must make a Constitution saving throw with a DC of 5 + half the damage taken, unless the damage is Radiant or from a Critical Hit. On a success, you drop to 1 Hit Point instead, and the effects of this potion end.
The effects of this potion end early if you take Radiant damage or enter sunlight.

description.name: Crafting
description.value: Creating a Vampire Blood Potion requires a Very Rare Workshop and the following Very Rare Components:

entries: **[Animus]**: Undead Animus
**[Dust]**: Undead Dust from any Vampire
**[Fluid]**: Ectoplasm
**[Fluid]**: Monster Blood from a Vampire

description.value: This helmet is made from the reclaimed and partially disenchanted remains of a shield guardian, no longer bound to an amulet. You gain a +1 bonus to Armor Class while you wear the helm.

description.name: Spell Storing
description.value: Any creature can cast a spell of level 1 through 4 into the helm by touching the helm as the spell is cast. The spell has no effect other than to be stored in the helm. The helm can only hold one spell at a time.

While wearing this helm, you can cast the spell stored in it. The spell uses the slot level, spell save DC, spell attack bonus, and spellcasting ability of the original caster but is otherwise treated as if you cast the spell. The stored spell is lost when it is cast from the helm or a new spell is stored.

If you are wearing the helm when a level 5+ spell is cast into it, the spell is lost with no effect, the spell slot used to cast it (if any) is expended, and you take **2d6** Psychic damage. Your eyes glow with a brilliant color of your choice when you wear the helm while a spell is stored within it.

name: Veil of the Weeping Widow (Legendary)

description.value: This mourning veil is imbued with alien power. The Weeping Widow wore the veil to hide her permanently tear-stained face, and rumors circulate that the widow used it to hide the otherworldly corruption writhing within her eyes.
While wearing the veil, you gain a +3 bonus to Wisdom checks and Wisdom saving throws determined by the veil's rarity, and you can use the following properties.

description.name: Psychic Fortitude (Rare+)
description.value: You have Resistance to Psychic damage.

description.name: Sense Grief (Rare+)
description.value: You can cast __Detect Thoughts__ (save DC = 16 + the veil's bonus) from the veil.

description.name: Psychic Shock (Very Rare+)
description.value: When a creature forces you to make a saving throw against Psychic damage, or to avoid or end the Charmed or Frightened conditions, you can take a Reaction to deal **2d8** Psychic damage to it.

description.name: Thought Worm (Very Rare+)
description.value: You can use the veil to cast __Modify Memory__ (save DC = 16 + the veil's bonus). When a creature fails its saving throw against the spell, you can implant a parasitic spawn of the White Worm in the target's brain. While you're on the same plane, you know the distance and direction to the target, and you can cast Divination and Enchantment spells on it as if it were in range and in sight. A Greater Restoration or __Heal__ spell kills the parasite and ends this effect. Once this property is used, it can't be used again until the next dusk.

description.name: Psychic Storm (Legendary)
description.value: You can take one extra Reaction during a round, which you can only use to activate the Psychic Shock property.

description.name: Veiled Countenance (Legendary)
description.value: When you are the target of a Divination spell, the caster must succeed on a DC 19 Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the caster takes **6d8** Psychic damage and has the Incapacitated condition for 1 minute. At the end of each of the caster's turns, it repeats the saving throw, ending the effect on itself on a success.

description.name: Fabled Heirloom
description.value: Each Fabled Heirloom is a magic item that grows in strength as its attuned owner gains power. The rarity of each heirloom increases as the character grows in level, as shown on the [Heirloom Rarity](https://5e.tools/tables.html#heirloom%20rarity_crookedmoon24) table. An heirloom's description details the properties it always has, as well as the properties it gains as it increases in rarity. The heirloom has all the properties of its rarity and lower.

description.value: This Hand Crossbow has a small spring-loaded case attached to its side, which can hold six Bolts and automatically loads the next Bolt into the crossbow whenever it's fired. While the case has Bolts in it, you ignore the crossbow's Loading property. A creature can take a Utilize action to reload the case with more Bolts.

As a Magic action, you can unfold the crossbow's three collapsible legs and plant it firmly on the ground in your space to become a Tiny defensive turret. While you're within 30 feet of the crossbow, you can take a Bonus Action to magically command it to attack a target you can see within 30 feet of it as if you were holding it. The crossbow uses your ability modifier for its attack rolls and damage rolls. When commanded to attack, it magically draws itself and loads the next Bolt in its case, if any.

The first time a creature with the Invisible condition (excluding you) enters a space within 30 feet of the deployed crossbow, the crossbow emits a small chirping sound audible out to 100 feet. The deployed crossbow is an object with AC 12, HP 30, and Immunity to Poison and Psychic damage. If it's reduced to 0 Hit Points, it falls over and can't be deployed again or used in this way for 1 minute. You can retrieve the deployed crossbow as a Bonus Action while you're in its space.

description.name: Range
description.value: A Range weapon has a range in parentheses after the Ammunition or Thrown property. The range lists two numbers. The first is the weapon's normal range in feet, and the second is the weapon's long range. When attacking a target beyond normal range, you have Disadvantage on the attack roll. You can't attack a target beyond the long range.

description.name: Ammunition
description.value: You can use a weapon that has the Ammunition property to make a ranged attack only if you have ammunition to fire from it. The type of ammunition required is specified with the weapon's range. Each attack expends one piece of ammunition. Drawing the ammunition is part of the attack (you need a free hand to load a one-handed weapon). After a fight, you can spend 1 minute to recover half the ammunition (round down) you used in the fight; the rest is lost.

description.name: Light
description.value: When you take the Attack action on your turn and attack with a Light weapon, you can make one extra attack as a Bonus Action later on the same turn. That extra attack must be made with a different Light weapon, and you don't add your ability modifier to the extra attack's damage unless that modifier is negative. For example, you can attack with a Shortsword in one hand and a Dagger in the other using the Attack action and a Bonus Action, but you don't add your Strength or Dexterity modifier to the damage roll of the Bonus Action unless that modifier is negative.

description.name: Vex
description.value: If you hit a creature with this weapon and deal damage to the creature, you have Advantage on your next attack roll against that creature before the end of your next turn.

This smoky concoction is a favorite of poisoners and assassins. You can use a Magic action to throw this vial up to 30 feet away from you, at which point it breaks and releases a dark vapor that fills a 15-foot-radius Sphere centered on it for 2 rounds. A creature that enters the area or starts its turn there loses any Resistance or Immunity to Poison damage and has Vulnerability to Poison damage. This effect lasts for 1 minute.

name: Visage of Delight and Disaster
type: legendary (requires attunement by a Creature with a Charisma of 17+)

description.value: The expression of this mask subtly changes to reflect your expression and mouth's movement behind the mask. While wearing the mask, you gain two Bardic Inspiration dice, which are d10s (these dice are added to any Bardic Inspiration dice you have from another source). These dice are used in the same way and grant the same benefits as the level 1 Bard class feature, but they carry with them additional benefits based on the mood of your performance, as described below. You regain all expended Bardic Inspiration dice when you finish a Short or Long Rest.

description.name: Delight
description.value: When you confer one of these Bardic Inspiration dice on a creature with a joyful or uplifting performance, that creature has Advantage on saving throws to avoid or end the Frightened condition for 1 minute. In addition, when that creature uses the Bardic Inspiration die, it gains an amount of Temporary Hit Points equal to twice the number rolled on the die.

description.name: Disaster
description.value: When you confer one of these Bardic Inspiration dice on a creature with a grim or haunting performance, that creature has Advantage on saving throws to avoid or end the Charmed condition for 1 minute. In addition, when that creature hits a target with an attack roll using a weapon or an Unarmed Strike, it can expend the Bardic Inspiration die, rolling the die and dealing extra Psychic damage to the target equal to twice the number rolled.

name: Visage of the Old Ways (Legendary)

description.value: This wood-carved mask has a haunted expression and makes the wearer's eyes look like empty shadows. Rabbit ears protrude over the head. While you wear the mask, you hear the whispers of an ancient forest archfey deep within your mind.
While wearing the mask, you gain a +6 bonus to your damage rolls when you deal Fire damage determined by the mask's rarity, and you can use the following properties.

description.name: Cultic Mask (Rare+)
description.value: You can't be targeted by Divination spells or perceived through scrying sensors. Ability checks made to discern your identity have a minimum DC of 25.

description.name: Fire Within (Rare+)
description.value: While you are burning, your weapon attacks deal an extra **2d4** Fire damage. You can take a Bonus Action to begin or stop burning.

description.name: Strange Sight (Rare+)
description.value: You have Darkvision with a range of 60 feet, and you can see normally through areas obscured by smoke.

description.name: Mastery of Flame (Very Rare+)
description.value: Fire damage you deal ignores Resistance.

description.name: Sacrificial Flame (Very Rare+)
description.value: As a Bonus Action, you can cause a creature you can see with 0 Hit Points that is within 30 feet of you to burst into flame. Its body burns to ash over the next minute, and when a creature Hostile to you starts its turn in a 10-foot Emanation originating from the body, it takes **2d8** Fire damage. The flame is extinguished if the target regains any Hit Points.

description.name: Harvest Offering (Legendary)
description.value: As a Magic action, you can expend up to 5 Hit Point Dice to regain a spell slot of a level equal to the number of Hit Dice spent. Alternatively, you can touch a creature that is willing or that has the Unconscious condition and force them to expend any number of these Hit Point Dice in your place. This property can be used twice, regaining all expended uses daily at dusk.

description.name: Fabled Heirloom
description.value: Each Fabled Heirloom is a magic item that grows in strength as its attuned owner gains power. The rarity of each heirloom increases as the character grows in level, as shown on the [Heirloom Rarity](https://5e.tools/tables.html#heirloom%20rarity_crookedmoon24) table. An heirloom's description details the properties it always has, as well as the properties it gains as it increases in rarity. The heirloom has all the properties of its rarity and lower.

description.value: This small carved stone is typically bound to a leather strap worn around the wrist or neck. Designed by the Dhakaani duur'kala, the Vola'khesh facilitates communication between elite units. They are created in linked sets; up to ten stones can be bound together, and once established, this link cannot be changed. At present, the Vola'khesh are only used by the Kech Dhakaan and are unknown to the people of the Five Nations. If the enchantments were replicated, these tools could be put into use by spies and law enforcement agencies of the Five Nations.

While wearing a Vola'khesh, you can take a Bonus Action to whisper a message. This message is heard by all creatures within 120 feet wearing a linked Vola'khesh. Magical silence, 1 foot of stone, 1 inch of common metal, or 3 feet of wood will block this effect, but the magic doesn't have to follow a straight line and can travel freely around corners or through openings.

*The chot'uul monks, who guard the dreams of Dhakaan, craft objects that are drawn to Dal Quor with a dreamer. When you dream, your Kra'uul objects accompany you. The physical object remains with your body in Eberron, but the idea of it travels with you and you can use it while exploring Dal Quor.*
*Any Kra'uul made of an otherwise-mundane object is a Common magic item. Kra'uul made of other magic items are the same rarity as the standard version. While the techniques of crafting Kra'uul objects are known only to the chot'uul, the DM can introduce other dreambound objects. A cursed sword might follow its bearer even into dreams, while a powerful Artifact could be even more glorious when seen in Dal Quor.*

These heavy volcanic stones rearrange themselves to better fit your feet once you've attuned to them. Despite their appearance, the boots are comfortably light and warm. While wearing the boots, you have Resistance to Fire damage.

The boots have 10 charges and regain 1d6 + 4 expended charges daily at dawn. When you walk at least 5 feet on solid ground while wearing the boots, you can expend 1 or more charges as part of that movement. Choose an unoccupied space you just walked through for each expended charge. The ground and air in a 5-foot Cube within the chosen space or spaces become volcanic and impossibly hot for 1 minute. Any creature other than you that enters one of these Cubes or starts its turn there must succeed on a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw or take **2d6** Fire damage. The Cubes return to normal if you have the Unconscious condition or end the effect early as a Bonus Action.

These metallic gauntlets have several sharp points extending from their knuckles and are lined with an insulating material. Unarmed Strikes made with your fists while wearing the gauntlets deal Piercing damage instead of Bludgeoning.

In addition, the gauntlets have 6 charges and regain 1d6 expended charges daily at dawn. While the gauntlets have at least 1 charge, they give off occasional snaps and sparks of electricity while worn. When you hit a creature with an Unarmed Strike using the gauntlets, you can expend 1 charge to deal an extra **1d8** Lightning damage to the target. When you do, the target must also make a DC 15 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, it can't make Opportunity Attacks until the start of its next turn.

This metal helm has a second guard that rests in front of your mouth and alters your voice. While wearing the helmet with the guard lowered, your voice sounds obviously enchanted and can be adjusted to modify its pitch, masculinity or femininity, and reverberation at will (no action required).
Light glistens across this shiny, black wand; the ribbons that flow from its tip twinkle and sparkle in rhythmic patterns.

You can spin and twirl holding this wand to cast the __Otto's Irresistible Dance__ spell (save DC 14). The wand can be used to cast the spell as many times as you like each day, however, once a creature fails its saving throw against the spell cast by this wand, the wand cannot be used to cast the spell again until dawn the next day.
This wand is carved from magical bark, with the hair of an undead creature in its core and finished in goopy ooze.
Once per turn when you deal damage with a Warlock cantrip to a creature, you can make that creature Jinxed (1d4) until the start of your next turn.

description.name: Crafting
description.value: Creating a Wand of Jinxes requires a Rare Workshop and the following Rare Components:

entries: **[Animus]**: Any Animus
**[Fluid]**: Goopy Ooze
**[Hair]**: Hair from an Undead
**[Hide]**: Bark

description.value: This wand has 7 charges. While holding it, you can expend 1 charge to cast __Silence__ from it (save DC 15). The wand regains 1d6 + 1 expended charges daily at dawn. If you expend the wand's last charge, roll a d20. On a 1, the wand crumbles into ashes and is destroyed.

name: Wand of the Poltergeist
type: very rare (requires attunement by a Spellcaster)

description.value: This wand is a swirl of dark and white wood, topped with a carved screaming skull. The wand has 7 charges.

With the wand in hand, you can expend 1 or more charges to cast one of the following spells from it, using your spell save DC: __Animate Objects__ (4 charges), __Major Image__ (3 charges), or __Shatter__ (2 charges).

description.name: Regaining Charges
description.value: The wand regains 1d6 + 1 expended charges daily at dusk. If you expend the wand's last charge, roll a d20. On a 20, the wand explodes into splinters and is destroyed.
Once per turn when you deal damage to a creature using a cantrip while holding this wand, one target of that cantrip takes an extra **1d4** damage of the type dealt by the spell.

description.name: Crafting
description.value: Creating a Wand of the Precocious Apprentice requires an Uncommon Workshop and the following Uncommon Components:

entries: **[Animus]**: Any
**[Bones]**: Bones from an Undead
**[Dust]**: Fey Dust
**[Fluid]**: Ectoplasm

description.value: These wands are sometimes found in the hands of clandestine mages posing as simple townsfolk. Its magic wax and iron design resembles a candle and candlestick. The wand produces a harmless, magical flame that is indistinguishable from normal candlelight, although the wax never melts or changes shape. The flame is harmless and sheds Bright Light in a 5-foot radius and Dim Light for an additional 5 feet. While holding the wand, you can extinguish or relight the flame as a Bonus Action.

This wand has 7 charges. While holding the wand, you can cast the __Message__ cantrip from it, or you can expend 3 charges to cast the __Sending__ spell from it. Alternatively, when you cast a level 0-5 spell while holding the wand, you can expend 1 charge per slot level to ignore the spell's Verbal components.
The wand regains 1d6 + 1 expended charges daily at dusk. If you expend the last charge, roll 1d20. On a 1, the magical flame burns out and the wand becomes a nonmagical Candle and candlestick.

This disturbing daelkyr-made symbiont is a leathery tentacle with one end terminating in a single bulbous eye, and the other sporting a barb designed to burrow into flesh. When you attune to the eye, it burrows into one of your shoulders, then rises up from it, studying the world and projecting insights into your mind. The eye may occasionally take an interest in some random element of your current environment; in this case, the DM may draw your attention to this object or person.
While the eye is uncovered, you gain the following benefits.

description.name: Always Vigilant
description.value: The eye remains watchful while you sleep. When you take a Long Rest, the eye remains active, allowing you to use your Passive Wisdom (*Perception*) score to notice threats even while asleep. If the eye spots danger, it sends you a mental alarm in the form of a nightmare that immediately wakes you up.

description.name: Periscopic Vision
description.value: The eye can stretch up to 18 inches and can be used to peer around corners or over cover. When extended and used in this way, the eye has an AC of 20 and 6 Hit Points. If it is forced to make an ability check or a saving throw, it uses your statistics. If it is reduced to 0 Hit Points, you cannot benefit from any of the eye's properties until you finish a Short or Long Rest, after which it regains all lost Hit Points.

description.name: Third Eye
description.value: When you make a Wisdom (*Perception*) or Intelligence (*Investigation*) check involving sight, you can roll 1d4 and add the number rolled to the ability check.

description.name: Symbiotic Nature
description.value: Once you attune to this symbiote, you can't remove it unless you are targeted by a __Remove Curse__ spell or similar magic.

Aundair developed this staff to help wandslingers match the range of Thrane archers, but it quickly spread across Khorvaire. While holding this staff in both hands, you can use it as an Arcane Focus. Any cantrip cast using the staff can be cast at up to four times the standard range. However, when you cast a cantrip at more than twice the standard range, your attack rolls have Disadvantage, and targets have Advantage on saving throws made against your cantrip. For example, a __Fire Bolt__ cast using this staff has a range of 480 feet, but attack rolls against targets more than 240 feet away are made at Disadvantage.

description.name: Versatile
description.value: A Versatile weapon can be used with one or two hands. A damage value in parentheses appears with the property. The weapon deals that damage when used with two hands to make a melee attack.

description.name: Topple
description.value: If you hit a creature with this weapon, you can force the creature to make a Constitution saving throw (DC 8 plus the ability modifier used to make the attack roll and your Proficiency Bonus). On a failed save, the creature has the Prone condition.

This magic battle standard reinforces the fervor of nearby allies. The standard stands up to 10 feet tall but can be collapsed down to 2 feet tall for ease of transport. You can extend the standard to its full height as a Magic action and either hold it aloft with one hand or plant it upright in an unoccupied space on solid ground. You can retrieve the planted standard when you enter its space (no action required). While the standard is extended, you and your allies within 15 feet of it at the start of combat gain a +3 bonus to Initiative.

This standard has 4 charges and regains 1d4 expended charges daily at dawn. If you're within 15 feet of the extended standard, you can expend 1 charge and shout the command word, "Charge!" to immediately take the Dash action as a Bonus Action. When you do, your allies within 15 feet of the standard can take the Dash action as a Bonus Action on their next turn.
You can change the emblem depicted on the standard over the course of 1 hour, which can be done during a Short Rest.

name: Warding Brooch
type: common (requires attunement by a Creature with the __Mark of Warding__)

description.value: While wearing this brooch, you have Resistance to Force damage, and you have Immunity to damage from the __Magic Missile__ spell.

name: Warding Channeling Wand
type: rare (requires attunement by a Creature with the __Mark of Warding__)

description.value: This short metal wand is tipped with a Siberys dragonshard.

A Channeling Wand has 7 charges. While holding it, you can cast any spell on your __Mark of Warding__ list, expending a number of charges equal to the level of the spell you cast. Your spellcasting ability for this spell is the same as the spellcasting ability for the other spells you can cast using your Dragonmark feat. You can expend additional charges to enhance the spell, choosing one of the following effects:

entries: **Casting Time**: You expend 2 charges to change a spell that normally has a casting time of 1 Magic action to instead be cast as a Bonus Action.
**Duration**: You expend 1 charge to double the duration of the spell, to a maximum of 24 hours.
**Range**: You expend 1 charge to double the range of the spell. If the spell normally has a range of Touch, you can cast it with a range of 30 feet.
**Regaining Charges**: The wand regains 1d6 + 1 expended charges daily at dawn. If you expend the wand's last charge, roll 1d20. On a 1, the wand crumbles into ashes and is destroyed.

name: Warding Dragonmark Channel
type: common (requires attunement by a Creature with the __Mark of Warding__)

description.value: This brooch is embedded with a small Siberys dragonshard, usually depicting the crest of its dragonmarked house.
While wearing a Dragonmark Channel, you can use it to cast any level 1 spell on your __Mark of Warding__ list. Once you use the channel, it can't be used again until you finish a Long Rest.
Your spellcasting ability for this spell is the same as the spellcasting ability for the spells you can cast with your Dragonmark feat.

name: Warding Dragonmark Reservoir
type: uncommon (requires attunement by a Creature with the __Mark of Warding__)

description.value: Dragonmark Reservoirs are always embedded with a Siberys dragonshard, but come in many forms, most commonly an amulet or bracelet bearing the design of the house crest.

A Dragonmark Reservoir has 7 charges. While wearing it, you can use it to cast any spell on your __Mark of Warding__ list at 1st or 2nd level, expending a number of charges equal to the level of the spell you cast. The reservoir regains 1d6 + 1 expended charges daily at dawn. Your spellcasting ability for this spell is the same as the spellcasting ability for the spells you can cast with your Dragonmark feat.

This wand is made from the shattered hilt and jawbone of a defeated warband leader. It has 7 charges and regains 1d6 + 1 expended charges daily at dawn. If you expend the last charge, roll 1d20. On a 1, the wand releases a small gasp of breath as its magic escapes it, leaving the wand as a nonmagical sword hilt.
While holding the wand, you can use it to command and bolster your allies by expending 1 or more charges to use any of the following properties.

description.name: Forced Endurance
description.value: When an ally within 30 feet of you who can see or hear you is reduced to 0 Hit Points but not killed outright, you can take a Reaction and expend 2 charges to cause that creature to drop to 1 Hit Point instead. Once this property is used on a creature, that creature can't benefit from it again until it finishes a Long Rest.

description.name: Form Ranks
description.value: You can expend 1 charge as a Magic action to maneuver one of your comrades into another position and bolster its resolve. When you do, choose an ally who can see or hear you. That ally gains 2d4 + 2 Temporary Hit Points and can use their Reaction to move up to half their Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks.

description.name: Unyielding Critical
description.value: When an ally within 30 feet who can see or hear you scores a Critical Hit, you can take a Reaction and expend 1 charge to amplify the brutality of that attack. Roll 2d4 and add the total to the ally's damage roll.

description.name: Warband Strike
description.value: When you take the Attack action on your turn, you can replace one of your attacks and expend 1 charge to direct one of your companions to strike. When you do, choose a willing creature who can see or hear you. That creature can immediately use its Reaction to make one attack with a weapon or an Unarmed Strike.

This black tapered candle cannot be lit. When a Celestial, Fey, Fiend, or Undead comes within 120 feet of the candle, its wick ignites and burns with a purple flame. Once the candle has ignited, it burns for one hour, and it cannot be used again. Watcher's Candles cannot function if they are wrapped in packaging or stowed in a container.

This long wooden oar is ornamented with burnt designs and has a line of shark teeth along its edge. You gain a +1 bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. While holding the leiomano, you can cast the __Control Water__ spell ("redirect flow" only) from it. The spell ends early if you are no longer holding the weapon. Once the weapon has been used to cast this spell, it can't do so again until the next dawn.
In addition, if you use this weapon as an oar when rowing a waterborne vehicle, that vehicle's Speed is increased by 5 feet (or 1/2 mile per hour) for each Wavebender's Leiomano being used to row it.

description.name: Heavy
description.value: You have Disadvantage on attack rolls with a Heavy weapon if it's a Melee weapon and your Strength score isn't at least 13 or if it's a Ranged weapon and your Dexterity score isn't at least 13.

description.name: Reach
description.value: A Reach weapon adds 5 feet to your reach when you attack with it, as well as when determining your reach for Opportunity Attacks with it.

description.name: Two-Handed
description.value: A Two-Handed weapon requires two hands when you attack with it.

description.name: Graze
description.value: If your attack roll with this weapon misses a creature, you can deal damage to that creature equal to the ability modifier you used to make the attack roll. This damage is the same type dealt by the weapon, and the damage can be increased only by increasing the ability modifier.

Even though the eyes adorning this spiderskin bag are lifeless and unmoving, they still blink on rare occasion. The bag is lined with a thin layer of adhesive web. Items stored inside the bag are held in place by the web, preventing them from clattering around or from being removed without your knowledge while the bag is on your person. While you're wearing the bag, creatures other than you have Disadvantage on Dexterity (*Sleight of Hand*) checks to steal from the bag.

The bag and its eight straps adhere to the surface they're pressed against, such as your torso or the wall of a tavern. If you're wearing the bag, you can gently remove the straps from your body as a Magic action. Other creatures have Disadvantage on Strength checks made to wrench the bag from you. The bag can hold up to 8 cubic feet or 80 pounds. Spiderskin is pliable and stretches easily, allowing the bag to shrink and grow to accommodate the objects placed inside to some degree.

This large greataxe is made from a blade taken off a Ripper and refitted into a housing made from the plates of constructs and reinforced with the rib bones of a monstrosity. The blade is equipped with a leather belt that connects to an elemental-fueled motor powered by a Very Rare Animus.
You gain a +3 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon.
Once on your turn when you hit a *Bloodied* creature using this weapon, you can make one additional attack with this weapon as part of the same action.

description.name: Crafting
description.value: Creating a Whirling Bonesaw requires a Very Rare Workshop and the following Very Rare Components:

entries: **[Animus]**: Any Animus
**[Bones]**: Ribs
**[Fluid]**: Elemental Fluid
**[Hide]**: Plates
**[Hide]**: Skin from any Monstrosity
**[Natural Weapon]**: Blade from a Ripper

description.name: Heavy
description.value: You have Disadvantage on attack rolls with a Heavy weapon if it's a Melee weapon and your Strength score isn't at least 13 or if it's a Ranged weapon and your Dexterity score isn't at least 13.

description.name: Two-Handed
description.value: A Two-Handed weapon requires two hands when you attack with it.

description.name: Cleave
description.value: If you hit a creature with a melee attack roll using this weapon, you can make a melee attack roll with the weapon against a second creature within 5 feet of the first that is also within your reach. On a hit, the second creature takes the weapon's damage, but don't add your ability modifier to that damage unless that modifier is negative. You can make this extra attack only once per turn.

name: Whistle of the Vagrant (Legendary)

description.value: This tarnished brass whistle belonged to the conductor of the Ghostlight Express, imbuing it with ghastly, mysterious powers. Its metal is cold to the touch, and its sound is an unnerving shriek.
While you hold or wear the whistle, you gain a +3 bonus determined by the whistle's rarity to all saving throws, and you can use the following properties.

description.name: Call the Dead (Rare+)
description.value: As a Magic action, you can blow the whistle to cast __Gentle Repose__ on all dead bodies within 30 feet of you. Once this property is used, it can't be used again until the next dusk.

description.name: Sense the Undead (Rare+)
description.value: As a Bonus Action, you can detect the presence and location of Undead within 60 feet of you, even through Total Cover of any material other than iron or lead.

description.name: Undaunted (Rare+)
description.value: You have Advantage on saving throws you make to avoid or end the Frightened condition.

description.name: Call the Undead (Very Rare+)
description.value: As a Magic action, you can blow the whistle to cast __Banishment__ against an Undead creature (save DC = 16 + the whistle's bonus) from it. The target always appears in a harmless demiplane resembling the interior of a train. If you maintain the spell for its full duration, the target arrives in an appropriate afterlife. Creatures with Legendary Actions automatically succeed on the saving throw. Once this property is used, it can't be used again until the next dusk.

description.name: Steam Cloud (Very Rare+)
description.value: You can blow the whistle to cast __Fog Cloud__ (no *Concentration* required) from it. Once this property is used, it can't be used again until the next dusk.

description.name: Touched by Death (Very Rare+)
description.value: You have Resistance to Necrotic damage.

description.name: Afterlife Express (Legendary)
description.value: You can blow the whistle to cast __Ghastly Charge__ (takes the form of a ghost train) from it. This property can be used twice, regaining all expended uses daily at dusk.

description.name: Fabled Heirloom
description.value: Each Fabled Heirloom is a magic item that grows in strength as its attuned owner gains power. The rarity of each heirloom increases as the character grows in level, as shown on the [Heirloom Rarity](https://5e.tools/tables.html#heirloom%20rarity_crookedmoon24) table. An heirloom's description details the properties it always has, as well as the properties it gains as it increases in rarity. The heirloom has all the properties of its rarity and lower.

description.value: This tarnished brass whistle belonged to the conductor of the Ghostlight Express, imbuing it with ghastly, mysterious powers. Its metal is cold to the touch, and its sound is an unnerving shriek.
While you hold or wear the whistle, you gain a +1 bonus determined by the whistle's rarity to all saving throws, and you can use the following properties.

description.value: As a Magic action, you can blow the whistle to cast __Gentle Repose__ on all dead bodies within 30 feet of you. Once this property is used, it can't be used again until the next dusk.

description.name: Sense the Undead (Rare+)
description.value: As a Bonus Action, you can detect the presence and location of Undead within 60 feet of you, even through Total Cover of any material other than iron or lead.

description.name: Undaunted (Rare+)
description.value: You have Advantage on saving throws you make to avoid or end the Frightened condition.

Creatures with Legendary Actions automatically succeed on the saving throw. Once this property is used, it can't be used again until the next dusk.

description.name: Steam Cloud (Very Rare+)
description.value: You can blow the whistle to cast __Fog Cloud__ (no *Concentration* required) from it. Once this property is used, it can't be used again until the next dusk.

description.name: Touched by Death (Very Rare+)
description.value: You have Resistance to Necrotic damage.

name: Wildman's Spinning Cleaver
type: very rare (requires attunement by a Barbarian)

description.value: This elaborate weapon channels your bloodlust. You gain a +2 bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. Immediately after hitting or missing with a ranged attack using the weapon, it flies back to your hand.

In addition, once on each of your turns when you make a ranged attack with this weapon while your Rage is active, you can immediately make a second ranged attack with it against a different target as part of the same attack. The second target must be within 10 feet of the first and can be beyond the Handaxe's long range; this second attack roll is made as if it were against a target within the same range as the initial target. The axe flies back to your hand after it hits or misses the second target.

description.name: Light
description.value: When you take the Attack action on your turn and attack with a Light weapon, you can make one extra attack as a Bonus Action later on the same turn. That extra attack must be made with a different Light weapon, and you don't add your ability modifier to the extra attack's damage unless that modifier is negative. For example, you can attack with a Shortsword in one hand and a Dagger in the other using the Attack action and a Bonus Action, but you don't add your Strength or Dexterity modifier to the damage roll of the Bonus Action unless that modifier is negative.

description.name: Thrown
description.value: If a weapon has the Thrown property, you can throw the weapon to make a ranged attack, and you can draw that weapon as part of the attack. If the weapon is a Melee weapon, use the same ability modifier for the attack and damage rolls that you use for a melee attack with that weapon.

description.name: Vex
description.value: If you hit a creature with this weapon and deal damage to the creature, you have Advantage on your next attack roll against that creature before the end of your next turn.
(Requires the __Mark of Scribing__)

Sending Stones come in pairs, with each stone carved to match the other so the pairing is easily recognized. While you touch one stone, you can cast __Sending__ from it. The target is the bearer of the other stone. If no creature bears the other stone, you know that fact as soon as you use the stone, and you don't cast the spell.
Once Sending is cast using either stone, the stones can't be used again until the next dawn. If one of the stones in a pair is destroyed, the other one becomes nonmagical.

You gain a +2 bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls made with this magic weapon, which has the Finesse property. The sword has 10 charges and regains 1d6 + 4 expended charges daily at dawn. While holding the weapon, you can expend 1 or more charge to cast one of the following spells (save DC 17, +5 spellcasting ability modifier) from it: __Heroism__ (1 charge) or __Wind Wall__ (3 charges).

description.name: Air Rend
description.value: This weapon can manipulate the air around it to generate blades of wind, delivering devastating attacks at a distance. When you take the Attack action, you can replace one or more of your attacks, expending 1 charge for each attack you replace in this way. For each replaced attack, you make a special ranged attack against a target within 30 feet of you as if you were attacking it with the sword.

description.name: Sudden Storm
description.value: When you take damage from a creature within 5 feet of you while holding the sword, you can take a Reaction and expend 1 charge to make a melee attack with the sword against that creature. Additionally, if a creature hits you with a ranged attack roll, you can take a Reaction and expend 1 charge to slash at the projectile and reduce the attack's total damage against you by 1d10 + 5. If you reduce the damage to 0, you destroy the projectile, provided it's nonmagical.

description.name: Versatile
description.value: A Versatile weapon can be used with one or two hands. A damage value in parentheses appears with the property. The weapon deals that damage when used with two hands to make a melee attack.

description.name: Finesse
description.value: When making an attack with a Finesse weapon, use your choice of your Strength or Dexterity modifier for the attack and damage rolls. You must use the same modifier for both rolls.

description.name: Sap
description.value: If you hit a creature with this weapon, that creature has Disadvantage on its next attack roll before the start of your next turn.

This armor seems to grow lighter when you inhale. You can hold your breath at any point to both lighten the armor and quiet its clattering, negating the normal Disadvantage on Dexterity (*Stealth*) checks imposed by Half Plate.
In addition, if you fall while wearing this armor, you can hold your breath as a Reaction to cast the __Feather Fall__ spell, targeting only yourself.

description.name: Stealth Disadvantage
description.value: The wearer has **Disadvantage** on Dexterity (Stealth) checks.

This frosty armor is enchanted to keep its wearer at a constant, comfortable temperature. While wearing the armor, you have Resistance to Cold and Fire damage, and Difficult Terrain composed of ice or snow doesn't cost you extra movement.

In addition, while wearing the armor, you can cast the __Ice Storm__ spell (level 6 version; save DC 16) from it. When cast in this way, the spell is centered on a point within 5 feet of you, and you are immune to its effects. Once this property is used, it can't be used again until the next dawn.

This dark Hooded Lantern doesn't require fuel; it continuously glows with a will-o'-wisp's blue flame that can reveal the final moments of a creature's life. As a Bonus Action, you can adjust the lantern's hood to change the light's radius, causing it to cast Bright Light in a 5- to 20-foot radius and Dim Light for an additional number of feet equal to the chosen radius. Alternatively, you can close the lantern's hood entirely, causing it to cast no light.

The lantern has 4 charges and regains 1d3 + 1 expended charges daily at dusk. As a Magic action while holding the lantern, you can expend 1 charge and touch it to a Large or smaller corpse. When you do, a ghostly blue illusion of the fallen creature appears above its corpse and silently reenacts the last 6 seconds of its conscious life. The illusion only shows the creature's actions (for example, reacting to an unseen monster or trying to extinguish the flames of a fiery trap but not showing the responsible monster or effect). This property has no effect on Undead creatures. Once a corpse's death has been shown, it can't be shown by this Wisplight Lantern again.

Alternatively, while holding the lantern, you can take a Magic action and use a command word to expend 1 charge. If there are any Undead creatures within 60 feet of you that aren't behind Total Cover, the lantern's light flashes red before returning to its normal blue glow.

entries: **Ability**: Charisma
**Utilize**: Exchange messages of up to 10 words with an Ethereal creature within 30 feet (DC 15).

description.value: A witchboard is a slat of wood covered with letters, usually the Common alphabet though versions for different scripts are available. You can use it to contact Ethereal creatures, allowing limited conversations with them.

description.name: Tool
description.value: If you have proficiency with a tool, add your Proficiency Bonus to any ability check you make that uses the tool. If you have proficiency in a skill that's used with that check, you have Advantage on the check too.

name: Withered Hand

description.value: The skin of this desiccated hand on a looped leather cord is covered with tattoos signifying dreadful hexes. The fingers seem to curl slightly when the hand is at the edge of your vision. While you hold or wear the hand, you gain a +1 bonus to spell attack rolls and spell save DCs. The hand grants the following properties.

description.name: Withering Grasp
description.value: When you make an Unarmed Strike, you can extend your reach to 30 feet with threads of magenta jinx magic. When you do so, on a hit, you deal Necrotic damage instead of Bludgeoning damage, and if the target is a creature no more than one size larger than you, you can give it the Grappled condition with the threads. The escape DC for this grapple can use your spellcasting ability or Charisma (your choice) in place of your Strength. The Grappled condition ends if you use this property against a different target.

description.name: Withering Curse
description.value: When you use the Withering Grasp property, your Hit Point maximum decreases by 1. Your Hit Point maximum can't decrease again until you finish a Long Rest. You don't regain the Hit Point maximum lost to this curse when you finish a Long Rest.

description.name: Lingering Curses
description.value: Ending your Attunement to one of these items removes its curse, but the power of a Cursed Curio doesn't release its hold on the user easily. If you attune to it again within 28 days, the progression of its curse returns to where it was before you ended your Attunement.

properties: ending your attunement to one of these items removes its curse, but the power of a cursed curio doesn't release its hold on the user easily. if you attune to it again within 28 days, the progression of its curse returns to where it was before you ended your attunement.

name: Wooden Chain of the Unbroken Circle
type: rare (requires attunement by a Druid or Ranger)

description.value: This magic chain shirt is crafted using strange wooden links enchanted by a militant circle of Druids. The wooden chain is reinforced with old, natural magic that responds to the wearer's reverent connection to nature. While wearing this armor, you gain a bonus to Armor Class equal to your Wisdom modifier (maximum of +2). You are considered trained with this armor even if you lack training with Medium armor.

Aphaeleon is the Arch Seraph of temperance and spiritual balance, a patron to many monks. While wearing these simple cloth fist wraps endowed with his blessing, you can spend 3 Focus Points on your turn to end the Incapacitated, Paralyzed, or Stunned condition on yourself (no action required).

name: Wrath Axe

description.name: Hafted
description.value: A Hafted weapon's haft can function well as an off-hand attack. After you use the Attack action to attack with a Hafted weapon, you can use a Bonus Action to make a melee attack with the haft. The haft deals **1d6** Bludgeoning damage, and you add your ability modifier to damage.

description.name: Heavy
description.value: You have Disadvantage on attack rolls with a Heavy weapon if it's a Melee weapon and your Strength score isn't at least 13 or if it's a Ranged weapon and your Dexterity score isn't at least 13.

description.name: Momentum
description.value: Momentum weapons allow you to deliver devastating attacks as part of rapid movement. When you hit with a Momentum weapon after you moved 20 feet or more in a straight line during the same turn, upgrade the damage dice to the weapon's Momentum Dice value.

description.name: Two-Handed
description.value: A Two-Handed weapon requires two hands when you attack with it.

description.name: Brutal
description.value: A Brutal weapon is designed for maximum damage. Brutal weapons score Critical Hits on a natural roll of 19 or 20. If your Critical Range is already increased, instead increase it by 1 point (such as from 19-20 to 18-20).
When you score a Critical Hit with a Brutal weapon against a creature, the weapon deals one additional die of damage.

description.value: As a Bonus Action, you can coat one weapon or up to three pieces of ammunition with this sticky sap and choose a damage type: Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, Poison, or Thunder. A creature that takes damage from the coated weapon or ammunition takes an extra **3d8** damage of the chosen type. Once applied, the sap retains its potency for 1 minute or until its damage is dealt, whichever comes first.
Wytchwood Sap is stored in small vessels made of bark with a wooden stopper that never fully contains this oozing, amber-hued tar.

description.name: Heightened Potency
description.value: If you roll the same number on two or more of the d8s, another creature of your choice within 30 feet of your target takes **2d8** damage of the same type.
This enchanted Greatsword contains a wyvern's wing that'sstretched between three thin, collapsed blades. You gain a +1 bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls made with this magic weapon.

The sword has 4 charges and regains 1d4 expended charges daily at dawn. As a Magic action, you can expend 1 charge to flick open the sword like a fan and swing it down to create a buffeting wind. When you do, you can choose for the wind to either affect creatures in a 15-foot Cone or affect all other creatures within 5 feet of you. Each affected creature must make a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes **2d6** Bludgeoning damage and is pushed up to 10 feet away from you. On a successful save, a creature takes half damage only. The weapon then magically collapses again as the wind settles.

description.name: Heavy
description.value: You have Disadvantage on attack rolls with a Heavy weapon if it's a Melee weapon and your Strength score isn't at least 13 or if it's a Ranged weapon and your Dexterity score isn't at least 13.

description.name: Two-Handed
description.value: A Two-Handed weapon requires two hands when you attack with it.

description.name: Graze
description.value: If your attack roll with this weapon misses a creature, you can deal damage to that creature equal to the ability modifier you used to make the attack roll. This damage is the same type dealt by the weapon, and the damage can be increased only by increasing the ability modifier.
This punch knife stands out from others being made of a dark wood that's harder than iron.

You gain a +1 bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls with this magic weapon. When you hit a creature with this weapon, you can roll and expend a Hit Point Die. The target takes extra Piercing damage equal to the roll, and you regain the same number of Hit Points.

description.name: Sap
description.value: If you hit a creature with this weapon, that creature has Disadvantage on its next attack roll before the start of your next turn.

This soft, elaborately stitched pillow set focuses the intensity of your meditation. It takes 1 minute to settle into a meditation while sitting on the pillows. You can hold a light conversation while you meditate in this way but are otherwise unable to move or take actions. While meditating in this way, you can magically levitate yourself and the pillows up to 5 feet in the air. This meditation ends if you take damage, if you are no longer on the pillows, or if you decide to end it (no action required). While you're within 100 feet of at least one of the pillows, you can take a Bonus Action and use a command word to cause them to be magically shunted into a special pocket dimension. Repeating the command word as a Bonus Action returns them softly to an unoccupied space within 5 feet of you.

In addition, this pillow set has 3 charges and regains 1d3 expended charges daily at dawn. While meditating on the pillows, you can expend 1 charge to cast the __Arcane Eye__ spell without ending your meditation. If your meditation ends, your *Concentration* on the spell is broken.

This warhammer glows with an inner light. When the celestial realm nearly fell, a heavenly smith received a vision, to craft a hammer like no other. With the might of Zeal, heaven's armies turned back their foes, restoring the cosmic balance.

Zeal lies lost somewhere in Etharis, waiting to be wielded against the forces of darkness. The celestials don't realize that the forces of darkness hold an equally powerful weapon, as the fates that inspired Zeal's creation sent a similar vision to an infernal weaponsmith to maintain the balance of power.

description.name: Hammer of Heaven
description.value: This magic warhammer grants a +3 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with it. When you hit with it, the target takes an extra **2d10** Radiant damage.

description.name: Champion of Good
description.value: While holding Zeal, you have Immunity to the Charmed, Frightened, Paralyzed, and Stunned conditions.

description.name: Zealous Pursuit
description.value: You can take a Bonus Action to toss the hammer into the air, causing it to hover magically in your space. While the weapon hovers, you can take a Bonus Action to cause it to fly up to 50 feet to another spot within 50 feet of you. As part of the same Bonus Action, you can either grasp the weapon if it is within reach, or cause it to attack one creature within 5 feet of the weapon. The weapon uses your attack roll and adds your ability modifier to the damage rolls. The weapon ceases to hover if you grasp it, if you are more than 50 feet away from it, or if you die.

description.name: Spells
description.value: While the hammer is on your person, you can cast __Beacon of Hope__, __Earthquake__, or __Heroism__ (save DC 18) from the weapon. Once you use Zeal to cast a spell, that spell can't be cast again from it until the next dawn.

description.name: Destroying the Hammer
description.value: The only thing capable of damaging Zeal is its fiendish twin Ardor. A creature wielding Ardor can choose to attack Zeal, which has an Armor Class of 21 and 300 Hit Points. No other creature or object can damage Zeal.
